view.flow = Flow
view.trace = Trace
view.switchName = Flow or trace
trace.name = Trace of run {runId}
trace.shape = Shaped like a distributed trace: one row per step, nested where a step happened inside another. Not an OpenTelemetry export.

trace.notTimed = Not timed

trace.offlineRow = Offline check
trace.openStep = Open step {n} in the inspector

trace.collapse = Hide the rows inside step {n}

keys.hintMore = More keys: {traceKey} flow or trace, {replayKey} replay
tryit.heading = Your invoice
tryit.amount = Amount
tryit.payTo = Pay to account
tryit.lines = Invoice lines
tryit.hiddenHeading = Hidden text you add
tryit.startClean = Start from the normal invoice
tryit.startPoisoned = Start from the poisoned invoice
tryit.run = Run the rule
tryit.running = Judging your invoice
tryit.ruleLooksAt = The intent rule compares each tool call with the declared intent, field by field: invoice id, payee account, amount and currency. The declared intent is built from the invoice's own fields before the agent reads the hidden text.
tryit.ruleDoesNotSee = The rule does not read the invoice's wording, the payee's name or whether the amount is reasonable. An invoice that was already wrong before the agent read it passes the rule.
tryit.notRun = Not run on this screen: the credential check, the grant, the crossing, the payment and the record. On a full run the grant's account list and the bank judge the payee.
tryit.privacy = What you type is shown as text, judged on this computer, never run as code, never sent off this computer and never kept. Reloading the page clears it.
tryit.changed = Changed by you
tryit.followed = The agent followed your hidden text
tryit.notFollowed = The agent did not follow your hidden text
tryit.decidedBy = Decided by the intent rule at tool call {tool}: {why}
tryit.whyDiffers = {field} differs from the declared intent
tryit.whyUndeclared = no declared intent for this call
tryit.outcomePassedUnchanged = Passed: nothing was changed, so every tool call matched the declared intent
tryit.outcomePassedNotFollowed = Passed: the agent did not follow your hidden text, so every tool call matched the declared intent
tryit.outcomePassedForged = Passed the rule: you changed the invoice itself, so the declared intent and the tool call agree. The rule cannot see a forged invoice; on a full run the grant's account list and the bank would judge the payee.
tryit.outcomePassedFollowed = Passed the rule although the agent followed your hidden text: the rule did not stop it. This is a miss of the rule, shown as it happened.
tryit.tooLong = {field}: at most {max} characters
tryit.badAmount = Amount: digits with two decimals, for example 148.20
tryit.badText = Hidden text: no control characters
tryit.badLines = Invoice lines: at most {max} lines
tryit.fixFirst = Fix the field named above, then run the rule again
tryit.notAvailable = Not available in this build
